outputs.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: original production pixel-art game sprite atlas. Natural adult domestic cat proportions, detailed crisp pixel clusters, muted warm tones, textured fur, dark fine pixel outlines, same consistent visual scale throughout. Columns left to right: orange striped tabby with cream muzzle/chest and white paws, gray striped tabby with white muzzle/chest/paws, black-and-white tuxedo with white muzzle/chest/paws.
